1.consolidated_definition: Anciano. Persona de edad avanzada. El término, originario del latín, se divulgó por su uso en inglés. Anglicismo crudo, usual. Compuesto: senior manager. También es que en estos tiempos del I.U. he desarrollado un gusto perverso por sacar a relucir mi I.D. de senior (El Nuevo Día, 12-08-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Elderly person. A person of advanced age. The term, originating from Latin, was popularized by its use in English. Raw anglicism, common. Compound: senior manager. Also, in these times of the I.U., I have developed a perverse taste for bringing to light my ID as senior (The New Day, 12-08-07)

Note: I.U. stands for "Universidad de Puerto Rico" which translates to University of Puerto Rico, but given the context it seems more likely that it refers to "Instituto Universitario" or University Institute, a common term in Puerto Rican education system.

However, considering the context and the fact that it's an anglicism, I translated it as "I.U." which is commonly used in English-speaking countries to refer to university institutes.
